end.summary: Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers using place values.
end.parentNote: Asha practised breaking numbers into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones. Diya used place-value parts while working, including identifying 6,042 as 6 thousands, 0 hundreds, 4 tens, and 2 ones. The mix-up about keeping a zero for an empty place continued through the last example, so it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise building numbers with place-value cards, always keeping a placeholder zero when a place is empty.
